concept.subject: An old stone house dug into a grassy hillside, its long sod roof grown over with grass, a wooden gable and a plank door at its left end.
concept.composition: The gable stands on the left with its peak at about a quarter of the width and a quarter of the height; the sod roof runs from it along the hillside to the right and down to about seven eighths of the width; the dry stone wall fills the band from a little over half to four fifths of the height, with the door near its left end; a meadow fills the bottom, and the wooded hillside with thin trunks the top.
concept.layout: 59 round pegs and 104 bricks, the stage's brick-heavy finale. The house is brick architecture traced from the picture: the gable's edges, beam and planks, the eaves board, the long wall's top course with two courses of single stones under it, the short wall left of the door, the door posts and two stones on the earth bank. The sod roof's ridge is a solid that sheds balls off the house; grass tufts sit on it and four spots of grass shelter under it on the roof's face. The hillside's logs, trunks, branch and bushes are bricks, its grass pegs, and two rows of pegs cross the meadow.

features: Brick-heavy last level (spec 8): 104 of its 163 objects are bricks

difficulty.note: The stage's hardest: the solid ridge turns balls away from the roof, so the grass sheltered under it is reached only by balls bounced back up from the eaves and the stones.

background.prompt: A photo of an old stone house dug into a grassy hillside, under an overcast sky. Its wooden gable stands on the left, the peak at about a quarter of the width and a quarter of the height, the eaves at about the left edge and two fifths of the width at a little over half the height; a long sod roof grown over with grass runs from it along the hillside and down to the right to about seven eighths of the width. A dry stone wall of flat gray stones fills the band from a little over half to about four fifths of the height, from the left edge to about four fifths of the width, with a plank door at about a fifth to a third of the width. A meadow fills the bottom fifth; the wooded hillside above has thin trunks, a fallen trunk at the top center and bare branches on the right.

picture.title: A rustic stone cottage with a grass roof nestled in lush Norwegian greenery.
picture.author: Andreas Berget
